Class PositionList

java.lang.Object
org.micromanager.PositionList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<MultiStagePosition>
public class PositionList extends Object implements Iterable<MultiStagePosition>
Navigation list of positions for the Stages. Used for multi site acquisition support. Consists of a list of MultiStagePositions and an Optional instance of MultiWellPlate.

TODO: Change into an interface and make a default implementation
